metadata.description: Agent-system design guidelines derived from Shijie Wang's "Back to Basics: A Philosophy for Agent System Design"

plugins.name: back-to-basics
plugins.description: Use when designing, reviewing, simplifying, or diagnosing agent systems or harnesses; deciding whether to add agent-level memory, planners, critics, orchestration, retrieval, tools, guardrails, or reasoning effort; comparing single- and multi-agent designs; or re-auditing architecture after a model upgrade.
